name: 2-Octanol
description: 2-Octanol (CAS 6169-06-8 ) is a secondary aliphatic alcohol used as a solvent and carrier in pharmaceutical and personal care manufacturing. It offers controlled solvency characteristics that suit sensitive formulation environments. This chemical is preferred where primary alcohols are too aggressive or volatile for the specific application. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it functions as a process solvent for active ingredient extraction and purification. Its moderate polarity helps isolate target compounds from complex matrices during the production process. Personal care formulators use it as a carrier solvent in fragrance systems and emollients. It is also utilized in skin-conditioning preparations to improve ingredient dispersion and skin feel. It serves as an intermediate in the synthesis of esters and other specialty chemicals used across cosmetic supply chains. In topical formulation development, its slower evaporation rate compared to short-chain alcohols supports controlled delivery. This ensures that actives are delivered effectively to the skin surface over a longer period. The product is available as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial-scale procurement. Technical and high-purity grades are the most commonly supplied to meet various industry needs. Specifications can be aligned to pharmaceutical process solvent requirements on request for specific projects. Buyers should confirm optical purity requirements when sourcing from their chemical supplier. Both racemic and enantiomerically enriched forms are commercially available depending on the intended use. This flexibility allows for precise application in both industrial and laboratory settings.
